evals.prompt: This function works but it's grown a lot of nested if/else and duplicated validation logic over the last few PRs. Can you clean it up without changing what it does?
evals.expected_output: An incremental, behavior-preserving simplification pass, scoped to the code in question, with tests checked after each step.
expectations: States it will preserve exact behavior (same inputs/outputs/side effects) before simplifying
Understands the existing code's purpose before changing or removing anything (Chesterton's Fence)
Applies changes incrementally rather than one large untested rewrite
Stays scoped to the code in question rather than refactoring unrelated parts
Mentions running/checking tests after simplification to confirm no behavior changed
